> Trichology clinic & hair studio based in Pflugerville, Texas. Hair and scalp analysis, individualized treatment plans and a holistic head spa with a Certified Trichologist, plus braids, locs and natural hair care, in a calm, spa-like studio on FM 685 in Pflugerville.

## Services
- Hair & scalp analysis: A full trichoscopy assessment of your hair and scalp, with a written report and a treatment plan.
- Holistic head spa: Scalp therapy, steam, massage and botanical rinses on a full-body massage head spa bed.
- Trichology treatment plans: Ongoing care for thinning, traction alopecia, inflamed or itchy scalps, built from your analysis.
- Braids, cornrows & twists: Gentle braiding that protects your scalp, with color combinations chosen to suit you.
- Sisterlocks, microlocs & dreadlocs: Starter locs, retightening, interlocking and loc detox, with scalp care built in.
- Natural hair & extensions: Silk presses, twists and coils, sew-ins and extensions, always with hair health first.

## About
For over two decades, Reclaim Your Crown Trichology and Shakim Creation Hair Studio have been a safe space for hair care in Pflugerville, now at 701 FM 685, Suite 120. Both are led by Sharon, a Certified Trichologist and Master Stylist, known to her clients as Dr. Sharon or simply Dr. B. Her work starts at the scalp: a hair and scalp analysis with trichoscopy, then an individualized treatment plan using The Holistic Approach, her own line of natural hair care products. Clients come to her with thinning, traction alopecia and inflamed scalps, and some have been with her since the studio first opened. The new studio is roomy and spa-like, with a holistic head spa, plus the full range of braids, cornrows, sisterlocks, locs, natural hair and extensions. She also teaches braiding and dreadlocs classes.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What happens at a hair and scalp analysis?
  A: Dr. Sharon uses trichoscopy to look closely at your hair and scalp, and talks through your medical history, diet, medications and lifestyle. You get a written summary with recommendations and a treatment plan made for you.
- Q: Can you help with thinning hair or alopecia?
  A: Many clients come in with thinning, bald spots, traction alopecia or an inflamed scalp. Results take time and consistency, and clients describe new growth within a few months of following their plan.
- Q: What is the holistic head spa?
  A: A relaxing scalp treatment with detox washes, botanical steam, scalp massage and herbal rinses, on a head spa bed that also gives a full-body massage. Choose the Express, Signature or Ultimate experience.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online any time through the studio's Vagaro page, or call (512) 202-5787. Extensions and loc installs need a consultation first. Please give at least 24 hours' notice to cancel.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Thursday 10 AM to 2 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM, by appointment. Closed Sunday, Monday and Friday.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: 701 FM 685, Suite 120, Pflugerville, TX 78660, with free parking. It is a short drive from Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, Manor and north-east Austin.
